blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Ideal Companion to any of our Children's Omega-3 Products
paragraphs: Essential vitamins and minerals for kids in tasty gummies they'll love.

Getting children to eat a healthy, well-balanced diet-or even take a daily multi-can be a challenge for many parents. That's why we've developed a line of gummy vitamins for kids that help make simple acts of nutrition a little easier (and tastier). These gummies provide 13 nutrients, including essential vitamins A, C, D and E, to help support growth and development during the early years and beyond. Nutrition that kids love, and parents can feel good about!

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: For 4 years and over, four gummies daily, with food, or as directed by your health care professional or pharmacist. Please ensure child chews each gummy thoroughly.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Soluble tapioca fiber*, pectin*, purified water, citric acid, sunflower oil, natural flavors, sodium citrate, rebaudioside M (reb M from fermented sugarcane), and carnauba wax.
*Adds a negligible amount of total sugars.
No gluten, milk derivatives, or synthetic dyes.
This product and its ingredients do not contain common GE genes or proteins.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool, dry place, away from sunlight. Do not take if tamper-evident seal is broken or missing. Keep out of reach of children.
Consult with your physician before taking this product if your child has a known medical condition, is taking medications.
